title: Lesson 46 · Expensive and uncomfortable
titleZh: 第46课 既昂贵又受罪

examples.en: The trip was expensive and uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 这次旅行既昂贵又受罪。

examples.en: The watch is too expensive for me.
examples.zh: 这块表对我来说太贵了。

examples.en: He had a long and uncomfortable trip.
examples.zh: 他经历了一次漫长而又难受的旅程。

examples.en: The wooden chair is uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 这把木椅子坐着不舒服。

examples.en: Workers began to unload the wooden boxes.
examples.zh: 工人们开始卸下木箱。

examples.en: They unloaded the goods from the ship.
examples.zh: 他们从船上卸下货物。

examples.en: Workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes.
examples.zh: 工人们开始卸下一批木箱。

examples.en: There is a wooden bridge over the river.
examples.zh: 河上有一座木桥。

examples.en: The boxes contained clothing.
examples.zh: 箱子里装着服装。

examples.en: The shop sells children's clothing.
examples.zh: 这家商店出售童装。

examples.en: One of the boxes was extremely heavy.
examples.zh: 有只箱子特别重。

examples.en: It was extremely cold last night.
examples.zh: 昨夜冷极了。

examples.en: It occurred to one of the workers to open the box.
examples.zh: 一个工人想到打开箱子。

examples.en: A good idea occurred to me.
examples.zh: 我想到了一个好主意。

examples.en: He was astonished at what he found.
examples.zh: 看到里面的情形，他吃惊不小。

examples.en: The news astonished everybody.
examples.zh: 这个消息使大家很惊讶。

examples.en: A man was lying on top of a pile of woollen goods.
examples.zh: 一个人躺在一堆毛织品上。

examples.en: There is a pile of books on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上有一堆书。

examples.en: He lay on a pile of woollen goods.
examples.zh: 他躺在一堆毛织品上。

examples.en: She wore a woollen coat.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件羊毛大衣。

examples.en: The man admitted hiding in the box.
examples.zh: 那人承认躲在箱子里。

examples.en: He admitted his mistake.
examples.zh: 他承认了自己的错误。

examples.en: He had been confined to the box for hours.
examples.zh: 他好几个小时被关在箱子里。

examples.en: The sick man was confined to bed.
examples.zh: 病人被限制在床上。

examples.en: No one could account for the heavy box.
examples.zh: 谁也解释不了那只箱子为什么这么重。

examples.en: How do you account for the mistake?
examples.zh: 你怎么解释这个错误？

words.meaning: n. 悉尼（澳大利亚地名）

examples.en: The plane arrived at Sydney airport.
examples.zh: 飞机抵达悉尼机场。

examples.en: Sydney is a big city in Australia.
examples.zh: 悉尼是澳大利亚的一座大城市。

examples.en: He was surprised at being discovered.
examples.zh: 他因被发现而感到吃惊。

examples.en: Scientists discovered a new star.
examples.zh: 科学家们发现了一颗新星。

examples.en: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip.
examples.zh: 他经历了一次漫长而又难受的旅程。

examples.en: We had a wonderful trip to the mountains.
examples.zh: 我们到山区旅行，玩得很开心。

sentences.en: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
sentences.zh: 有只箱子特别重，可谁也弄不清是怎么回事。

sentences.en: He was astonished at what he found.
sentences.zh: 看到里面的情形，他吃惊不小。

sentences.en: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
sentences.zh: 箱内有一个人正躺在一堆毛织品之上。

sentences.en: The man was ordered to pay £3,500 for the cost of the trip, but the normal price of a ticket is only £2,000!
sentences.zh: 此人被责令支付3,500英镑的旅费，而正常票价只需2,000英镑！

article.en: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport, workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes.
article.zh: 当一架来自伦敦的飞机抵达悉尼机场时，工人们开始卸下一批木箱。

article.en: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
article.zh: 有只箱子特别重，可谁也弄不清是怎么回事。

article.en: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
article.zh: 突然一个工人想到打开箱子看看。

article.en: He was astonished at what he found.
article.zh: 看到里面的情形，他吃惊不小。

article.en: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
article.zh: 箱内有一个人正躺在一堆毛织品之上。

article.en: The man was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away.
article.zh: 那人由于被发现而感到非常吃惊，甚至都没有企图逃跑。

article.en: After he was arrested, the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
article.zh: 此人被逮捕后，承认他是在飞机离开伦敦前躲进箱里的。

article.en: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip, for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
article.zh: 他经历了一次漫长而又难受的旅程，因为他在木箱里闷了十八个多小时。

article.en: The man was ordered to pay £3,500 for the cost of the trip, but the normal price of a ticket is only £2,000!
article.zh: 此人被责令支付3,500英镑的旅费，而正常票价只需2,000英镑！
